question: Who must sign the Authority to Release Personal Information form?

claims.text: The Authority to Release Personal Information form (IMM 5475) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.
claims.quote: The [IMM 5475 form (PDF, 593.57 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5475e.pdf) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual.

basis: The applicant submitted an Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual form (IMM 5475) in the authority_to_release_info upload slot for case e5640785a8c957a693d4da097babd255.

Document instance evaluation against IMM 5475 compliance rules reveals a form scope mismatch defect: the submitted form designates a paid legal representative to conduct business and act as an authorized immigration representative on behalf of the applicant, whereas Form IMM 5475 is strictly limited to releasing personal information to a designated individual. Appointing a legal representative or conducting business with IRCC requires Form IMM 5476 (Use of a Representative).
